title: Field Botany Volunteer
description: Field volunteer assisting a U.S. Forest Service botanist in the Cleveland National Forest. Katya Hernandez-Pol introduced me to rare and invasive plant surveys, more complex plant ID using dichotomous keys, and ArcGIS Field Maps. Before I left for my seasonal job in Idaho, she had begun sending me on solo missions to locate, ID, and remove invasive species. I also started keeping an informal field notebook during this time, a habit which I continue to this day.
duties: Assists with rare plant and invasive species surveys using ArcGIS Field Maps
Identifies native and invasive plants using field guides and the Jepson Manual
Independently performs hand-removal of invasive plants
Began project to create digital flashcard resource for practicing ID for the CNPS field botanist certification
